ana (sales): FYI – fintech prospect wants a 2-week POC: Java SDK ingestion, streaming (SSE preferred, websocket fallback), structured JSON events for downstream, and a tool-call pattern for account lookup. They also sent a security questionnaire and want a ballpark monthly cost.

dmitri (solutions): What QPS and token profile? that decides hosted vs Dedicated.

ana (sales): They said 100-180 rps typical, spikes to 300. Avg chat tokens ~25, occasional batch loads ~3-4k tokens. P95 target ~250ms.

lee (eng): 100-300 qps is coverable. Recommend Dedicated pool with batching + prefix cache. For large batches use async batch API so we don’t evict KV cache. Will post a tiny Java streaming + tool call example.

dmitri (solutions): Please include minimal SSE snippet and a tool_call/tool_response sample schema we can hand their devs. Also call out proxy buffering quirks.

lee (eng): Snippet (pseudo):
```java
RedwoodClient c = new RedwoodClient(KEY);
c.stream(model, prompt, event -> {
  // event.kind: TOKEN | TOOL_CALL | TOOL_RESPONSE | DONE
  System.out.println(event.raw());
});
```
Tool call pattern: {"kind":"TOOL_CALL","name":"getAcct","args":{"id":"..."}} -> {"kind":"TOOL_RESPONSE","result":{...}}. Structured event example: {"type":"txn","ts":"...","payload":{"acct":"123","amt":4500}}

lee (eng): Proxy notes: some CDN/proxies buffer SSE until ~64KB. Recommend websocket fallback and small chunk flush (<=1KB) + heartbeat every 10s. Also tune client retry: fast-fail then fallback route.

tara (security): For questionnaire propose ephemeral STS creds + IP allowlist. If they insist on customer-controlled HSM or on-prem logging, escalate to Private. I'll take the questionnaire, 48h turnaround.

noah (pricing): Quick order-of-magnitude: assume ~20-40M tokens/mo. PAYG hosted ~ $0.0009/token => $18k-$36k/mo. Dedicated commit starting ~$12k-$18k/mo; effective token price can drop to ~$0.0004-$0.0006 with a multi-month commit. POC: offer 14 days free up to 5M tokens then capped trial rate.

log-bot: Audit demo link: https://internal.redwood/audit/fin-poc (RO) :lock:

dmitri (solutions): Integration checklist for customer: confirm L7 proxy behavior (buffering/keepalive), provide IP ranges for allowlist or plan STS, validate SSE chunking or use websocket fallback, adopt small message chunks and heartbeat.

ana (sales): Action items: 1) Lee: post Java example + schema (today). 2) Tara: questionnaire first pass (48h). 3) Noah: one-page cost estimate (today). 4) Dmitri: integration checklist (today). Customer call scheduled tomorrow 11am PT.

lee (eng): Uploaded snippets to #sales-files.

noah (pricing): Sent one-pager to Ana DM.

tara (security): Questionnaire draft uploaded; flagged 2 items for legal.

ana (sales): Thanks team . I'll share notes after the call. :rocket:
